title: Cyrus and the Typewriter
author: Wendell Brightwater
blurb: Gideon Winterbourne, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
